scope: Derive deterministic alert eligibility from P11-D importance, P11-E reliability and P11-F freshness
Emit INFORMATIONAL, IMPORTANT, CRITICAL or SUPPRESSED severity
Suppress EXPIRED, BLOCKED and QUARANTINED content
Build deterministic narrative-input envelope preserving source/content/entity/topic/sentiment/reliability/freshness evidence
out_of_scope: Notification channel delivery, quiet hours and escalation UX (P23-F)
Signal probability, risk approval and execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: active task none, active lock none, open PR none
tests: HIGH importance + HIGH reliability + FRESH maps to CRITICAL
